description.value: Shawarma Corner is a Middle Eastern fast-food spot on Columbia Street in downtown New Westminster, specializing in shawarma wraps, donairs, and falafel plates. It holds strong crowd-sourced ratings (4.3–4.7 stars across over 600–1,000 reviews), suggesting reliable quality for a mid-ride refuel. Both indoor and outdoor seating are available, and online pickup ordering makes it easy to grab a meal without a long wait.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: stands at 37m; rack at 73m; rack at 95m; stands (8 spaces) at 99m. Total: 8 spaces.
